CustomField.description: Credentialing status in one line for the deal's surgeon list (Robert, 2026-11-27): Not set, Not started, Booked for <course date>, Attended, Credentialed on <credentialed date>.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Where the surgeon is with credentialing.
CustomField.label: Credentialing
CustomField.formula: CASE(TEXT(ROSA_Credentialing_Status__c), "Not started", "Not started", "Booked", IF(ISBLANK(ROSA_Course_Date__c), "Booked", "Booked for " & TEXT(DAY(ROSA_Course_Date__c)) & "/" & TEXT(MONTH(ROSA_Course_Date__c)) & "/" & TEXT(YEAR(ROSA_Course_Date__c))), "Attended", "Attended", "Credentialed", IF(ISBLANK(ROSA_Credentialed_Date__c), "Credentialed", "Credentialed on " & TEXT(DAY(ROSA_Credentialed_Date__c)) & "/" & TEXT(MONTH(ROSA_Credentialed_Date__c)) & "/" & TEXT(YEAR(ROSA_Credentialed_Date__c))), "Not set")
